verdict.rationale: Mercury documents automatic receipt-to-transaction matching via email/upload ('Email or upload receipts and we'll auto-attach them to the right card transaction. You don't lift a finger.'), directly addressing capture without manual entry, and supports transaction categorization via API/categories. However, this still requires the user to email or upload the receipt rather than fully automatic capture at time of card swipe, and there's no community/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of this specific feature in practice.
